headline: Which checks apply, and when?
reading: T-Mobile announced its agent platform, but the public record leaves pre-launch staff input unknown. In Germany, consult the works council during planning, agree before using monitoring-capable tools, and tell customers at first contact that they are dealing with AI unless it is obvious. Since 2021, Telekom checks eligible systems against its group framework agreement. Systems outside it can require a separate agreement. The duration of those checks for Telekom's service agents is unknown.
